offering_description.value: Insurance distribution platform supporting independent agencies and agents who sell personal and commercial property and casualty and other insurance. Provides carrier access, technology and back-office support, and earns commissions from carriers. Also runs corporate-owned agencies and a managing general agency.

primary_services.value: insurance brokerage; agency support and carrier access; managing general agency services; technology and back-office support for agencies

customer_segment.value: B2C: individuals and families buying home, auto and personal insurance; B2B: small and mid-sized businesses buying commercial insurance, independent agencies using the platform

end_markets.value: personal insurance; commercial insurance; property and casualty insurance; life and health insurance

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: commissions from insurance carriers on policies placed, renewals and contingent commissions; service fees: fees from managing general agency and agency support services
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: places client policies with insurance carriers through affiliated and owned agencies; service provider: provides carrier access, technology and support to independent agencies

geography_served.value: US national: Agencies across many US states, with concentration in Texas and the South

specialization.value: related lines: agency network, corporate-owned agencies and managing general agency, all in insurance distribution

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: network of independent agencies and multi-line agents; own locations: corporate-owned insurance agencies

regulatory_exposure.value: high: insurance agent and agency licensing regulated by state insurance departments

notes: Size and state concentration are approximate.
